inclusions.text: Hotel pick-up from Marsa Alam at 2:00 PM
inclusions.source: Pick-up from your Marsa Alam hotel happens at 2:00 PM.

inclusions.text: Hotel transfer, private to your party
inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the Nefertari itself is a shared vessel, run by its crew.

inclusions.text: Welcome drink on the upper deck
inclusions.source: On arrival at the marina, you board the Nefertari and are given a welcome drink on the upper deck — a practical courtesy as much as a ceremonial one, since the air conditioning below is best appreciated after ten minutes in the afternoon sun.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided alongside the meal and welcome drink.
Snorkelling equipment is provided; bring your own towel for drying off afterwards, as towels are not supplied.

inclusions.text: Dinner on board: seafood and beverage menu
inclusions.source: Dinner is served on board: a seafood and beverage menu timed to coincide with the light dropping behind the western escarpment.

inclusions.text: Guide and captain identifying species in the observation saloon
inclusions.source: Once anchored above the reef, passengers descend to the observation saloon, where the guide and captain identify species through the windows — the coral formations are close enough that a child's face pressed to the glass will fog it.

exclusions.source: Snorkelling equipment is provided; bring your own towel for drying off afterwards, as towels are not supplied.
